WITH group_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    ID,
    AVG(ANA) as avg_ana
  FROM Examination
  GROUP BY ID
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ana) as mean_value
  FROM group_averages
  WHERE avg_ana IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  ga.ID as patient_id,
  ga.avg_ana as average_ana,
  ga.avg_ana - om.mean_value as excess
FROM group_averages ga
CROSS JOIN overall_mean om
WHERE ga.avg_ana IS NOT NULL
  AND ga.avg_ana > om.mean_value
ORDER BY excess DESC, ga.ID DESC
LIMIT 10
